descriptions.zh-Hans: 柏林咖喱香肠的自画菜单，用文字标出酱的位置。
descriptions.en: A homemade Berlin currywurst menu labeling the sauce in words.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在柏林吃草莓馅面包球后画的菜单。
descriptions.en: A menu drawn after the messenger’s strawberry-filled Pfannkuchen in Berlin.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在柏林电视塔望河后画的原创便纸，签名横了过来。
descriptions.en: An original TV Tower river sketch with a sideways signature.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使记下柏林点心缺口的自画纸，没有夹带食物。
descriptions.en: A homemade paper recording a bite in a Berlin pastry.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 蒂尔加滕公园歇步时改过的个人纸清单。
descriptions.en: A personal list revised during a pause in Großer Tiergarten.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使亲手折的柏林观景记忆卡，展开后签名能够正着读。
descriptions.en: A hand-folded Berlin view memory whose signature reads upright when opened.
